description: This file contains styles for a React application, setting global and component-specific CSS rules, including themes, button styles, modal layouts, and responsive design features for a note management app.

classes.name: ocean-theme
classes.description: A class that sets the font family and applies a background color for the ocean-themed application.

classes.name: ocean-header
classes.description: A class for the header section of the ocean-themed application, defining positioning and layout.

classes.name: note-card
classes.description: A class that styles individual note cards, including hover effects and structure.

classes.name: modal-overlay
classes.description: A class that styles the modal overlay, centering it on the screen with a background.
